hypothesis: The unchanged activity predicate may improve which stocks are selected from the original relative-price-trend top-k list at the same target count and nominal allocation.

selection.trend_rule: Rank formation adjusted close divided by oldest close of the proved preceding normal-observation lookback; original target ceiling and fixed tie order.
selection.activity_rule: Only after the original trend top-k selection, retain names whose formation turnover is at least threshold times the exact median of the preceding normal-observation lookback.
selection.parameter_values: All parameters, including lookback, threshold, seed, holding sessions, slots, commission and slippage, are fixed by the byte-pinned reference specification.

timing_and_accounting.entry_and_exit_proxy: Existing daily opening-price execution proxy and due-or-later nonfrozen sale rule; not an actual intraday execution certificate.
timing_and_accounting.tax: Existing dated KRX settlement-aware tax policy, without rate refitting.
timing_and_accounting.compulsory_events: Preserve original-investment grouping and verified LG/LX raw-price/allotment accounting; new origins require their own event and unit coverage.

expanded_discovery_preparation.scope: The same original dated large/liquid source partitions and formation calendar within the spent post-2019 reference window; no newly selected periods.
expanded_discovery_preparation.priority: Repair original unresolved eligibility and retained-baseline proof gaps in formation-date then issue-code order, before inspecting additional holding returns.
expanded_discovery_preparation.matched_control: At each formation and lag, first m of the original trend rank, where m is the combo target count known before opening. Shared targets retained; per-target nominal allocations equal; fills and realized exposure reported separately.
before_new_comparison_family: Complete influential eligibility, baseline, availability and source-period proof; freeze the expanded population before holding outcomes.
Resolve holding quote, corporate action, successor and price-unit coverage for the exact potential origins; no inherited new-asset waiver.
Separately register and independently verify own event-arm dispersion and a compatible effect/cost-unit power design; current failed or undefined prerequisite remains failed or undefined.
Register final controls, denominators, costs, missingness, stopping and reporting rules before additional performance reads; no automatic underpower exception.

evidence_boundary.lineage: Post-BX/BY exploratory hypothesis using already observed discovery results; not an independent confirmation.
evidence_boundary.ledger_audit: A separate BZ saved-book audit checks the three differing selections; it cannot create additional independent selection cases.
